title: Practice 5: за and под: going behind, under

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Вы ответите за ___ (своё деяние, acc. pl.).
exercises.prompt: You will have to be responsible for what you've done.
exercises.why: **деяние → деяния** (acc. pl.). Neuter, inanimate; nominative plural деяния. Declines like DLI's здание — every plural form has the same endings (A. pl. здания). Ending -е → -я.  **свой → свои** (acc. pl., agreeing with деяния). A possessive — declines like DLI's мой. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. деяние · деяния · деянию · деяние · деянием · деянии; pl. деяния · деяний · деяниям · деяния · деяниями · деяниях.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  «Notice the similarity of the endings of the possessives to the form of «они».» мой · моё — моего — моему — моим — о моём; моя — моей — мою; мои — моих — моим — моими — о моих. — DLI, Lessons 47–48.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Не шевелясь, картинно, они держали под ___ (уздцы, acc. pl.) худых лошадей.
exercises.why: **уздцы → уздцы** (acc. pl.). A plural-only noun (it has no singular); nominative plural уздцы. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension (plural only): уздцы · уздцов · уздцам · уздцы · уздцами · уздцах.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Вы арестованы за ___ (незаконное проникновение, acc. sg.).
exercises.why: **проникновение → проникновение** (acc. sg.). Neuter, nominative singular in -ие. Declines like DLI's здание — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. здание). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **незаконный → незаконное** (acc. sg. n., agreeing with проникновение). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новый (every form has the same endings): A. новое. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. проникновение · проникновения · проникновению · проникновение · проникновением · проникновении; pl. проникновения · проникновений · проникновениям · проникновения · проникновениями · проникновениях.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

Declension: sg. лад · лада · ладу · лад · ладом · ладе; pl. лады · ладов · ладам · лады · ладами · ладах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.why: **плечо → плечо** (acc. sg.). Neuter, nominative singular in -о. Declines like DLI's окно — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. окно). Declension: sg. плечо · плеча · плечу · плечо · плечом · плече; pl. плечи · плеч · плечам · плечи · плечами · плечах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Вы можете погасить задолженность по кредитам за ___ (год, acc. sg.)?
exercises.prompt: Can you pay off your loans in a year?
exercises.why: **год → год** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's дом — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. год · года · году · год · годом · годе; pl. годы · годов · годам · годы · годами · годах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

**присяга → присягу** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -а. Declines like DLI's газета — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. газету). Ending -а → -у.  Declension: sg. присяга · присяги · присяге · присягу · присягой · присяге; pl. присяги · присяг · присягам · присяги · присягами · присягах.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Том - борец за ___ (право, acc. pl.) человека.
exercises.prompt: Tom is a human rights activist.
exercises.why: **право → права** (acc. pl.). Neuter, inanimate; nominative plural права. Declines like DLI's окно — every plural form has the same endings (A. pl. окна). Ending -о → -а.  Declension: sg. право · права · праву · право · правом · праве; pl. права · прав · правам · права · правами · правах.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Беда, попадетесь под ___ (пьяная рука, acc. sg.).
exercises.why: **рука → руку** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -а. Declines like DLI's газета — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. газету). Declension: sg. рука · руки · руке · руку · рукой · руке; pl. руки · рук · рукам · руки · руками · руках.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Что это за ___ (нарост, acc. pl.) на дубовых листьях?
exercises.prompt: What are those outgrowths on the oak leaves?
exercises.why: **нарост → наросты** (acc. pl.). Masculine, inanimate; nominative plural наросты. Declines like DLI's стол — every plural form has the same endings (A. pl. столы). Ending — (no ending) → -ы.  Declension: sg. нарост · нароста · наросту · нарост · наростом · наросте; pl. наросты · наростов · наростам · наросты · наростами · наростах.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Кен всегда заступается за ___ (мать, acc. sg.), когда родители ссорятся.
exercises.prompt: Ken always stands up for his mom when his parents quarrel.
exercises.why: **мать → мать** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -ь. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. мать · матери · матери · мать · матерью · матери; pl. матери · матерей · матерям · матерей · матерями · матерях.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  «The nouns мать and дочь take -ер- before the ending in all cases except the nom. and the acc. sing.: матерью, дочерью.» — DLI, Lesson 30.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).
